# yt-dlp EJS 0.8.0

Unmodified solver assets from the official PyPI wheel:
https://pypi.org/project/yt-dlp-ejs/0.8.0/

Wheel SHA-256: `79300e5fca7f937a1eeede11f0456862c1b41107ce1d726871e0207424f4bdb4`.
Upstream: https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs
The included LICENSE covers EJS and bundled meriyah/astring.
Uta runs the solver in an isolated, memory/time-limited QuickJS context.
No cookies, host functions, filesystem access or network access enter that context.
